Tooltip_SQSF_Pack: Load through irrigation management. Depletion leaves a reusable empty pack; empty packs also recover medicine.
Tooltip_SQSF_Empty: Refill with any care medicine of this size without more planks, or use it to recover stored medicine.
Tooltip_SQSF_Legacy: Legacy conversion only: load into a device to retain whole doses and discard fractions. No new residue is generated.
